verdict.rationale: Wave documents invoice status tracking (viewed, due, paid), overdue reminders, and general reports (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow), but nothing in the evidence mentions an accounts receivable aging report or per-customer balance views. Those invoicing features are adjacent to the story, not the capability itself, so the axis applies but no supporting evidence exists.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can track accounts receivable with aging reports and per-customer balances
